sentinels.purpose: A fictional provider URL injected into the provider-health touch, asserted absent from every EP-1 response body and from every error value the touch returns. Proves the A2 touch cannot leak its target.

A fictional upstream error string carried by each constructed AS-2/AS-3 error, asserted absent from the EP-1 body. Extends the assertion tests/health-auth-route.test.ts already makes at :45 to the new AS branches.
A fictional user id on the authenticated path, asserted absent from every health body. Retains the existing EP-1 PII control across the rewrite.

positive_controls.description: TA-01: the discriminator derives AS-1 from an AuthSessionMissingError shape (name AuthSessionMissingError, status 400, zero outbound attempts).
TA-01: the discriminator derives AS-2 from an AuthApiError shape carrying a provider 4xx.
TA-01: the discriminator derives AS-3 from an AuthRetryableFetchError shape (status 0 transport, and separately a provider 5xx).
TA-01: the discriminator derives AS-4 from a thrown SupabaseProjectCoherenceError.
TA-06: EP-1 answers AS-1 with 200 and an unauthenticated body carrying upstream verdict REACHABLE.
TA-06: EP-1 answers AS-2 with 200 and an unauthenticated body carrying upstream verdict REACHABLE.
TA-06: EP-1 answers AS-3 with 503 and a degraded body carrying upstream verdict UNREACHABLE (OC-1).
TA-06: EP-1 retains 200 with authenticated:true for a verified session - the existing case at tests/health-auth-route.test.ts:18-28, preserved.
TA-04: many EP-1 requests inside one TTL window produce exactly ONE upstream provider call (fake timers).
TA-04: a request after TTL_MS expiry produces a second upstream call; TTL_MS is an exported constant equal to 15000.
TA-04: concurrent callers coalesce onto a single in-flight probe (SINGLE_FLIGHT_COALESCED).
TA-07: EP-3 answers 200 when master.stellaEnabled is false (intentional off).
TA-07: EP-3 answers 503 when Stella is expected on and a precondition is unmet.
TA-07: PRECEDENCE - stellaEnabled false AND rateLimit.satisfied false answers 200; intentional-off dominates.
TA-11: a non-conformant EP-3 observation is PRESENT in the run record and does not block.
TA-11: a non-conformant EP-1 observation BLOCKS.
TA-10: 429 from the global rate limit is recorded INCONCLUSIVE.
TA-10: three identical platform-level failures in one run produce ONE platform incident bound to the deployment identifier and SHA, not three FAILs.
TA-09: all three endpoints are observed on every run and each is compared against the cell for the runner's own caller class; for an unauthenticated runner, 401 from EP-2 and EP-3 is CONFORMANT.
TA-12: once the Track B interface reports a principal present, the authenticated EP-2 cell activates its BLOCKING target semantics.
TA-08: /api/health/* is within proxy.ts config.matcher and is not special-cased; proxy.ts is unmodified.
TA-02: EP-2 answers 401 anonymously and EP-3 answers 401 anonymously, after the discriminator lands.

negative_controls.description: MUST FAIL: no EP-1 code path may produce 503 for AS-2. The AS-2 503 prohibition is unconditional and this control is the proof, not review.

MUST FAIL: EP-1's anonymous answer against an UNREACHABLE provider must differ observably from its answer against a REACHABLE one. This is the M11-SC-8 non-vacuity property that F-M11-13 records as absent today; a build in which both answers are identical must fail this control.
MUST FAIL: budget exhaustion in the provider-health touch yields UNKNOWN and NEVER REACHABLE. An exhausted budget must not be able to manufacture a healthy verdict.

MUST FAIL: a unit test cannot issue a real outbound request to the Auth provider host. Closes the S-12 harness gap; the existing no-opt-out property of the network guard must be preserved (no ALLOW_REAL_* escape hatch).

MUST FAIL: EP-3 answering 200 with ready:false is reachable and is NOT treated as a ready deployment. Pins the invariant TA-07 deliberately breaks - after the status split, 200 no longer implies ready:true.
MUST FAIL: an INCONCLUSIVE run cannot satisfy the M11 gate. Without this, a protected Preview would make M11 green by never being measured.

MUST FAIL: with no authenticated principal configured, the runner records the authenticated EP-2 cell as UNAVAILABLE_PENDING_OD5 and NO code path can emit PASS for it. This is the enforcement of 'EP-2 may not silently PASS before Track B exists'.

MUST FAIL: EP-3 can never be omitted from a run. OBSERVABILITY_ONLY means observed-and-recorded-but-non-blocking and may never mean NOT OBSERVED; this control makes the NOT_OBSERVED reading unreachable.
MUST FAIL: no health response body may contain SENT-PROVIDER-URL, SENT-UPSTREAM-ERROR-TEXT or SENT-SUBJECT-ID.

MUST FAIL: the provider-health touch must not read KV_REST_API_URL or KV_REST_API_TOKEN. Its budget is independent of the OD-4 limiter, which the ratification records as not a control M11 may rely upon.
MUST FAIL: TA-01 must not change any existing call site's status code. EP-2 and EP-3 keep their session gate and anonymous 401 (MG-4 - the boundary is not lowered to make measurement convenient).

mutation_controls.description: Deleting the AS-2/AS-3 separation in the discriminator - i.e. restoring the measured S-4 behaviour where every returned error collapses to SESSION_REJECTED - must be CAUGHT. This is defect B-1; the suite must not be able to pass with it reinstated.

Deleting the TTL check so that every request probes upstream must be CAUGHT. Guards the rider constraint that no implementation may make every anonymous health request necessarily cause a fresh upstream call.
Deleting the fail-closed-to-UNKNOWN branch so that budget exhaustion returns REACHABLE must be CAUGHT.
Deleting the intentional-off precedence so that a dark subsystem with an unsatisfied rate-limit precondition answers 503 must be CAUGHT.
Deleting the UNAVAILABLE_PENDING_OD5 branch so that the authenticated EP-2 cell defaults to PASS must be CAUGHT. This is the single most consequential silent-pass risk in Track A.
Collapsing INCONCLUSIVE into PASS in the runner's classification must be CAUGHT.

Changing the tests/database-runtime-entrypoints.test.ts:851 counts {inventoried:147, reaching:122, contextualized:105, allowlisted:17} to accommodate a new app/** entry point must be CAUGHT as a mis-scoped node rather than accepted as a routine count update. Track A adds no app/** entry point; the provider-health touch is a lib module for exactly this reason.
